rounds.text: The bull case resting on low headline multiples and high reported earnings masks a severe working capital and cash generation crisis [E1, E15, E24]. Operating cash flow for Mar 2026 crashed to negative Rs 13.07 Cr, resulting in a disastrous cash conversion ratio of -1.81x against reported profits [E24, E25]. This cash drain pushed free cash flow down to negative Rs 18.34 Cr in Mar 2026, forcing the company to ramp up borrowings nearly fourfold to Rs 9.60 Cr [E26, E29]. Underlying this cash destruction are ballooning high debtors of 234 days and a near doubling of working capital days from 93.1 days to 176 days [E42, E43]. Furthermore, domestic institutional investors have fled the stock, slashing their holdings by 2.24 percentage points down to a negligible 0.07% as of Jun 2026 [E32]. Conceded: the company displays strong multi-year sales and profit growth alongside high historical returns on equity [E12, E15, E40].
